references.text: The clans of the Gershonites and their duties at the tabernacle are first described here, forming the basis for the census in Num 4:41
Moses and Aaron receive a command to count the Gershonites and define their service, which this verse summarizes the result of
The preceding verses give the details of the counting of Gerson's sons that verse 41 summarizes
Parallel summary of the counting of the Merarites, with the same wording that Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord's command
Concluding summary of the entire census of the Levites, confirming that everything was done according to the Lord's command through Moses
Gershon is mentioned as one of Levi's sons, who is the ancestor of the clans counted in Num 4:41
A previous counting of the Levites carried out by Moses and Aaron according to the Lord's command, the same authority confirmed in 4:41
